primary_question: Can a daily, neutral-anchored K1->K2 launch episode with gradual banking and a moving-average runner produce sparse cross-altcoin trend exposure that transports across three chronological phases?
independent_unit: A symbol-level launch episode; inference and matched-control significance are clustered by entry week so simultaneous altcoin moves are not treated as independent evidence.
universe_frozen_before_outcomes: 52 explicit locally cached current OKX USDT perpetual instruments, excluding BTC and ETH. No symbol is selected by later return, volatility rank, or future volume.
daily_aggregation: Exactly 96 unique contiguous 15-minute UTC bars; incomplete or duplicate UTC days are discarded and indicator segments reset across any missing daily bar.
shared_signal_invariant: A completed directional K1 crosses the fast MA after a causal neutral/compression episode. The first completed K2 within the allowed gap must retest the fast MA with its shadow, keep its body predominantly on the trend side, and every intermediate close must remain on the directional side.
episode_invariant: One K1 attempt consumes one neutral episode even when no K2 follows; repeated crossings in the same range cannot rearm the strategy.
audit_data: 2024-01-01 through 2025-06-30; opened only after a committed selection receipt
confirmation_data: 2025-07-01 through 2026-04-30; opened only after a committed audit receipt and never used to retune
fixed_initial_stop: K2 structural extreme plus 0.10 ATR outward; reject risk outside 0.50 to 4.00 ATR
portfolio_contract: 0.5% closed-equity risk per accepted trade, no more than six simultaneous positions and no more than 3% open initial risk
selection_rule: Sequential coordinate selection; at each stage the incumbent remains a candidate. A replacement must satisfy the registered sample and right-tail gates and improve median-minus-half-standard-deviation fold mean by at least 5bp.
primary_acceptance: Audit and confirmation must each have positive net mean, PF above one, at least two-thirds positive time folds, at least 55% positive symbols, week-clustered sign-flip p<0.01, positive matched-random excess with p<0.01, at least 80% of baseline p95, positive portfolio return, and closed-equity max drawdown no worse than 20%.
single_feature_baseline: K1 range-release vote alone, evaluated without changing entry, stop, banking, runner, cost, or phase boundaries.
